v5.label: Kilix V5, before direct weight edits

limits: Synthetic editor-authored cases, not an independent human evaluation.
The 1175 development cases informed weight edits; the 208 confirmation cases were frozen before .21 selection.
The upstream comparison is post-selection; no weights or prompts were retuned for it.
CPU and GPU observations reuse cases and are not independent samples.
Identical Kilix prompt, tools, parser and admission rules; no model-specific prompt tuning.
Accuracy-run latency excluded because CPU and GPU jobs may overlap.
Raw correctness requires the Kilix native tool-call format. Prose refusals are format errors; zero empty-list false abstentions does not imply zero refusals or schema failures.
timing_limits: 24 fixed cases in two opposite model orders, fresh server each run, after accuracy jobs exited. Output lengths differ. External CPU sampling cannot observe processes born or exited inside the interval.
